reported.title: Press during open valve is lost, not queued
reported.description: scanStart() only calls openZone() when !zoneOpen (line 49), and held is updated to the current level every settled scan (line 53). A press that settles while the valve is still open is therefore consumed: held becomes true, and when the valve closes the button is already held so no new burst starts. The measured evidence shows D10 missed 1 of 3 triggers, with no pulse starting within 100 ms of the trigger at 400 ms. D10 missed 1 of 3 trigger(s): D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 400 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Zone valve relay on D10; start button on D6 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D6 opens the valve (D10 HIGH) for 500 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 12 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D10 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `zone n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
